description: Fetch conferences and their transcripts now, for the caller's connected meeting accounts. Optional: account_id (just that one), since (ISO date, default 30 days back — transcripts appear with delay at every provider, so a short window misses exactly the meeting somebody is waiting for), fetch_transcripts (default true). Already-fetched transcripts are not fetched again.

since.description: Only entries from this point in time on (ISO 8601)

name: sync_meetings
